name: history-01
title: History 01 - What A Workspace Has Been Charged For And Consumed
description: A real table of what a workspace has been charged for and what it has consumed: a moment, a reference in the mono face as an identifier is machine notation, a kind, an amount composed through the Price component so no symbol is hardcoded, an optional quantity that needs a caller written unit, a state whose tone comes from the semantic roles and whose words are required, and a link. The order is the caller own and the Block never sorts, because a history this Block reordered would be a claim about which charge came first and on a billing surface that claim is a bill.
